entity.description:
Adrahil II was the twenty-first Prince of Dol Amroth.

Adrahil was the only son of Angelimir. He succeeded his father in TA 2977. He was the father of Ivriniel, Finduilas, and the famed Prince Imrahil. He reigned for thirty-three years, dying in TA 3010.
